# GenerateCustomQR
> Free custom QR code generator with logo embedding, 40+ matrix dot styles, 51 CTA text frames, multi-color gradients, and instant vector SVG, PDF, and high-res PNG export with no watermark.

## Core Features & Capabilities
- **URL to QR Code**: Convert any website link into a customized QR code.
- **WiFi QR Code**: Auto-connect guests to WPA/WPA2/WPA3 WiFi networks without typing passwords.
- **vCard QR Code**: Share digital contact cards (vCard 3.0) directly into phone address books.
- **Logo Embedding**: Overlay custom SVG/PNG brand logos with auto-padding and Level H error correction.
- **Matrix Styling**: 40+ module dot styles, 25 eye frames, and 20 eyeball designs.
- **Print & Export Formats**: Lossless SVG vectors, 300 DPI print-ready PDFs, and ultra-high-resolution PNG up to 8192px.
- **Batch CSV Processing**: Generate up to 500 branded QR codes from CSV in a single ZIP download.
- **QR Code Scanner**: In-browser camera video stream and image file reader powered by computer vision.

- [How to Make a QR Code](https://generatecustomqr.com/how-to-use): Step-by-step tutorial and best practices guide.
